title: Captain Seth Sportfishing
specs: Fish for striped bass, bluefish, fluke, sea bass, blackfish, porgy, and sharks
Boat is a 48' Chesapeake deadrise with 800 Hp engine, cruises at 18 kts
Captain Seth holds a U.S.C.G. 100 ton Master’s License with over 28 years experience
Arrivals after 6 am will miss their trip
No fishing license required; boat's license covers all paying customers
Bring sunscreen and warm, water resistant layers; motion sickness medication recommended
Open boat trips limited to 16 passengers
Open boat shark trips limited to 8 people

blurb: Guests fish for striped bass, bluefish, fluke, sea bass, and more aboard the 48' Chesapeake deadrise boat Aubrey Joy. Trips include open boat bottom fishing and private charters. The boat accommodates up to 16 passengers for open trips and up to 18 for private charters.
extraNote: Non-refundable deposit required: $125 for open boat trips, 50% for private charters · Trips subject to reschedule due to dangerous or un-fishable weather; rain does not cause reschedule · Notify within 72 hours to reschedule once per season; original deposit transferred to new trip · Gratuities for mates not included; standard is 15-20% of trip cost · Thamesport Marina, 260 Pequot Avenue, New London, CT 06320
